summary: Streak-based Q&A habit app: users can log any number of questions per day; streak increments when at least 1 question is logged; missing a day (0 questions) resets streak and applies a flat ₹20 fine; unanswered input defaults to 0 questions.
architectural_notes: Question count input should default to 0 when not provided/blank.
Streak increments on days with question_count >= 1; streak resets and fine applies on days with question_count == 0.
Fine model is flat: ₹20 per missed day (no scaling).

existing_features.title: Replace the frontend daily tracking UI that uses 5 checkboxes with an input that lets the user enter the number of questions solved today. If the input is left empty, treat it as 0 questions. Saving the value must call the existing updateTodayProblems mutation with the entered value (or 0 if blank).

Update the frontend reminder logic and copy to remove the “complete 5 problems” framing. The reminder should be based on maintaining the streak rule: show a reminder when today’s logged questions are 0 (i.e., they have not solved at least 1 question yet).

new_feature_requests.summary: Allow users to log any number of questions per day (remove compulsory 5-question rule).
Daily streak logic: streak increases if user logs at least 1 question in a day; if 0 questions, streak resets and a flat ₹20 fine is applied.
Add user input for number of questions completed; if user leaves it blank, treat it as 0 questions.

Update backend daily reset logic so users can log any number of questions per day (no fixed goal of 5), and apply streak/fine rules as: (a) if questions solved for the day is >= 1, increment current streak by 1 and apply no fine; (b) if questions solved for the day is 0, reset current streak to 0 and apply a flat fine of 20 rupees (always 20, not scaled). Persist the daily record with the day’s questionsSolved and the penaltyApplied amount.

Update backend APIs that set daily problem count to accept any non-negative count (Nat) without enforcing an upper limit of 5, and ensure the daily count update still triggers a reset first if the user is past the daily reset boundary (so the update applies to the new day).

projectName: Allow any daily question count with streak on ≥1 and flat ₹20 fine on 0
